title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 53
paragraphs: So when the answers were brought back and Croesus heard them, he was delighted with the oracles, and expecting that he would certainly destroy the kingdom of Cyrus, he sent again to Pytho and presented the men of Delphi—having first ascertained their number—with two staters of gold for each man. In return, the Delphians granted to Croesus and to the Lydians precedence in consulting the Oracle, exemption from all payments, and the right to front seats at the games, together with this privilege in perpetuity: that any of them who wished might become a citizen of Delphi.
